action.name: Exact-head padless HyperBoost immediate reversible validation
action.value: Balanced and Automatic to paired HyperBoost mode 7, immediate typed readback, exact Balanced restoration, and fresh post-restoration pad-absence observation

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once on the exact laptop while the cooling pad USB and external power were disconnected.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed paired HyperBoost mode 7 readback on both thermal channels.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully once to the saved Balanced and Automatic pair.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed the exact saved Balanced state and a fresh post-restoration physical pad-absence observation.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator bound OpenBlade.Capture 0.17.0+0f56b0c1, exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00 and PID 02E0, inactive Synapse and OpenBlade service, two pad-absence observations, Balanced and Automatic baseline, and admitted FullPower330W adapter classification.
The validator submitted one paired HyperBoost transition, confirmed paired mode 7, restored the saved pair once, and confirmed Balanced without retry or manual recovery.
A fresh physical VID/PID presence observation after restoration again confirmed that the cooling pad was absent.
The private bounded semantic record binds the exact Capture executable and successful typed result; it contains no raw HID path, serial, user path, or process identity.

limitations: This exact-head run proves one immediate reversible transition only; it does not establish sustained thermal behavior, adapter-transition behavior, or installed-service lifecycle recovery.
The result is scoped to RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00, Balanced and Automatic, an admitted FullPower330W adapter, and confirmed physical pad absence.
Production padless HyperBoost remains disabled until every reviewed sustained and lifecycle gate is satisfied.

productionAdmission.reason: Immediate exact-head transition and restoration evidence is complete, but sustained, adapter, low-power, and crash-recovery gates are independently required.

notes: capturedAtUtc records creation of the bounded semantic evidence record after the interactive run; the validator did not emit a timestamp.
The OpenBlade service and competing Razer applications remained inactive.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored by the validator.
